text_block_list.name: Emilia Puck
text_block_list.text: IT'S HOT!!
text_block_list.orig_text: あっつ～い！！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Are you all right? It's dangerous to stuff your face with takoyaki like that, so please eat them little by little.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫ですか？
たこ焼きをひとくちで頬張るのは危険ですので、
少しずつお召し上がりください。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... It's hot, but so delicious! I wonder if this is also something unique to the beach?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はふ、
ふー、
ふー……
熱い、
けど、
すごーく美味しい！
これも
海ならではの食べ物なのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: It's more of a local beach house staple than a "beach dish". Other popular dishes include yakisoba noodles and grilled corn.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海というよりは、
海の家の定番料理ですね。
他にも
焼きそばや焼きとうもろこしなどが有名です。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I see. I'm curious about all of them, but... I wonder if I'll be able to eat them all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなんだ。
どれも気になるけど……
全部食べ切れるかしら。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: If you're moving around in the ocean, you'll naturally get hungry, so there's no problem. Or so I'd like to say, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
海水浴で体を動かしていれば、
自然とお腹が空きますので
問題ありません。
と、
言いたいところですが……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: It's way too hot! If I go swimming in the sea like this, I'll turn into a boiled octopus before I even get a chance to cool off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがに暑すぎだろ！
これで海水浴なんて、
涼む前に茹でダコになっちまう！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: The past few days have been presented with an unusual hot temperature. Normally the beach house would be booming in business right now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここ数日、
尋常でない猛暑が続いておりますからね。
本来ならば
かき入れ時の海の家も……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: So that's why the shopkeeper was crying with joy when I bought some takoyaki.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たこ焼きを買った時に
お店の人がすごーく泣いて喜んでたのは、
そういう事情だったのね。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Let's rest at the beach house for now. If we stay on the beach like this, we'll probably collapse too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひとまずは
海の家で休憩いたしましょう。
このまま砂浜にいたら、
わたくしたちも倒れてしまいそうです。

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's hot even in the shade... I'm so sensitive to heat, I can't stand it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
日陰にいても暑い……
繊細なボクには耐えきれないよ～

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: To think that your big fluffyness would turn out to be your biggest enemy right now. I don't even feel like petting you right now... I feel so sorry, Puck.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか至高のモフモフが仇になるとはな。
さすがに今は、
モフる気にもならねぇ……
ごめんな、
パック。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: But thanks to the heat, the shaved ice tastes delicious. I feel like I could have as many refills as I want♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
暑いおかげで、
かき氷が美味しく感じるわ。
いくらでもおかわりできそう♪

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Please be careful, Lady Emilia. If your stomach gets too cold, it will poison your body, and if you eat too much at once, your head will feel numb.
text_block_list.orig_text:
エミリアさま、
お気を付けください。
お腹を冷やし過ぎると体に毒ですし、
一気に召し上がると
頭がキーンとなってしまいます。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow... So this is what "feeling numb" actually means? It's not good to eat too much... I thought I could get through this heat with the power of shaved ice...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
いたた……
これが
キーンってなるってこと？
食べすぎもよくないのね……
かき氷の力なら、
この暑さも乗り切れると思ったんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: With the power of ice, huh...? I've got a flash of inspiration! In that case, why don't we make something even more amazing than shaved ice?
text_block_list.orig_text:
氷の力で、
か……
閃いたぜ！
だったら、
かき氷よりももっとすごいものを
作っちまえばいいんじゃねぇか？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: You're already on my vibe, Bro. How quick on the uptake! That's how it has to be!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすが兄弟。
話が早いぜ！
そう来なくちゃな！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you talking about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
何の話？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, you'll understand right away. First, I have a favor to ask of you, Emilia-tan and Puck~
text_block_list.orig_text:
安心しろ、
すぐにわかる。
エミリアたんとパックに
お願いがあるんだ──

text_block_list.name: Man in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text: This heat's really bad. Should we head home?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この暑さ、
やっぱヤベーなー
そろそろ帰るか？

text_block_list.name: Woman in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text: Eeeehhh...? Since it's so empty, we should hang around a little longer. I'm starting to get a nice tan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー、
せっかく空いてるんだし
もうちょっと粘ろうよー
今イイ感じに日焼けしてきたとこだしー

text_block_list.name: Man in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text: Tan she says, more like a sunburn... Hm? Hey, look at that! What's with it?! There's a huge piece of ice standing in the middle of the ocean!
text_block_list.orig_text:
日焼けってオマエ……
ん？　
おい、
あれ見ろよ！
なんだありゃ、
海の中に
でっかい氷が立ってるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Woman in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text: Seriously?! WWhat's that, what is it?! I feel like it's starting to get a little chilly. Let's go take a closer look!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジで～！？　
な、
何あれ！　
でも
ちょっとひんやりしてきたかも。
近くに行ってみよう！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Alright, here we go. I wonder if this works out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よいしょ、
っと。
こんな感じでいいのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Yup, it is exactly as what we imagined earlier! As expected of you, Emilia-tan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
完璧に俺たちのイメージ通りだ！
さすがだぜエミリアたん！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Still, having just a floating big piece of ice like this is kinda boring. I feel like there's a lot of potential to experiment with here... Isn't that right, Bro?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし、
でかい氷を浮かべるだけじゃ味気ねぇ。
こいつには
もっと遊べる可能性を感じるぜ……
そうだろ？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Sounds nice～... That's what I wanted to hear!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいね～
っつうことは、
アレだな！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A short while later, the iceberg that Subaru and {0} had devised and scraped together became a giant slider floating in the sea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しばらくの後。
スバルと{0}が構想を練り、
皆で削り上げた氷山は、
海に浮かぶ巨大なスライダーとなった。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Mmm, this feels so good! Let's slide down one more time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んーっ、
すごーく気持ちいい～っ！
もう１回滑りましょう！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Emilia, please be careful not to fall. The sea water is very salty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
エミリアさま、
落ちないようにお気を付けください。
海の水は
大変塩辛いので。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll be careful! But Kokkoro-chan, I can see you also want to slide one more time. You're kind of fidgeting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
気をつけるわ！
でも、
コッコロちゃんも、
もっと滑りたいんでしょう？
なんだかそわそわしてるもの。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: It is a masterpiece devised by My Lord and Lord Subaru, after all. It is the duty of a servant to My Lord to enjoy his creations to the fullest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
主さまとスバルさまが考案した
力作でございますからね。
存分に楽しみつくすのも、
従者の務めです。

text_block_list.name: Children in swimsuit
text_block_list.text: I'll slide off next!
text_block_list.orig_text:
次、
ぼくが滑る～っ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa, before we knew it, it seems a line formed to slide down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おー、
いつの間にか順番待ちの行列ができてるな。

text_block_list.name: Man in a swimsuit
text_block_list.text: I heard that there was a fun event going on at the beach. I never imagined I'd be able to have fun like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海で
面白いイベントをやってるって聞いて来たんだよ。
まさかこんな遊びができるとはな。

text_block_list.name: Lady in a swimsuit
text_block_list.text: This is the first time I've seen an ice slide. And I've lived a long life already.
text_block_list.orig_text:
氷の滑り台なんて初めて見たよ。
長生きするもんだねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Young and old, men and women alike, it seems this slide has become the talk of town already.
text_block_list.orig_text:
文字通り、
老若男女を問わず
大人気でございますね。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Makes sense considering it's a limited time event that will merely last a day and then "melt away". Everyone has a weakness for the word "limited"...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いずれは溶けちまう、
今日限りの限定イベントだしな。
人間は誰だって、
限定って言葉には弱いんだ……！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Maybe it'll melt even faster than that~ I'm not really made of ice, but this heat is enough to melt even me eventually. I might be reaching my limit in terms of strength.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もっと早く溶けちゃうかもね～
氷でできてるわけじゃないボクだって溶けちゃいそうな暑さだし。
強度的にもそろそろ限界かも。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Huh, really? In that case, we should make an announcement before this slide collapses...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
そうなのか？
なら、
スライダーが崩壊する前にアナウンスを……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Finally, it's my turn again. Alright, let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっと順番が回ってきたわ。
それじゃ、
しゅっぱーつ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Oh no, the path has half disappeared...! KYAAAHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
道が途中でなくなって──
きゃあああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: EMILIA...!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: エミリアっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Pwah... It seems I plunged headfirst into the sea!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷはぁっ……
頭から思いっきり、
海に突っ込んじゃった！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Emilia, are you injured? If anything hurt you, make sure to get out of the water immediatly so I can patch you up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
エミリアさま、
お怪我はございませんか？
何かあれば、
すぐに海から上がって手当てを……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kokkoro-chan! As you told me, the sea water really is salty! Maybe we can use it to flavor our food!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえコッコロちゃん！
海の水って
本当にしょっぱいのね。
お料理の味付けに使えるかも！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Hehe, indeed, that is what the ocean's all about. I'm glad you're enjoying it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
それが海というものでございます。
楽しんでいただけているようで、
何よりですね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Oh, that ice block used to be so big, but look at how tiny it is now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんなに大きな氷だったのに、
ずいぶん小さくなっちゃったわ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Can't resist Mother Nature's power, huh...? Well, it can't be helped. There are no more courses to slide on, so the ice slide will soon be closed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大自然のパワーには抗えないか……
ま、
仕方ねぇよ。
もう滑れるコースもないし、
氷のスライダーはそろそろ店じまいだな。

text_block_list.name: Children in swimsuit
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone! That slide you made was really fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんたち、
ありがとう！
滑り台、
すごく楽しかったよ！

text_block_list.name: Man in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text: Thanks to your idea, it's gotten cooler, and it looks like it's easier to play around here now. Seriously, thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかげで涼しくなって、
まだまだ遊べそうだし？
マジ
感謝っすわ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're welcome. Since you came all the way to the beach, I'm glad you managed to find a way to have a good time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
どういたしまして。
せっかく海に来たんだもの、
楽しく過ごせたのならよかったわ！

text_block_list.name: Children in swimsuit
text_block_list.text: Then, I'd like to go and make a castle made up of sand next!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあぼく、
次は砂のお山作りたい！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: A castle... made of sand?
text_block_list.orig_text: 砂のお山？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: It's a fun activity that can only be done at the sea, where sand moistened with seawater is piled up. There are various ways to shape the sand based on objects or ideas, the castle is usually the most popular one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海水で湿らせた砂を積み上げる、
海ならではの遊びですね。
細かい造形に拘るなど、
作り方も様々です。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: There's a lot of depth to making sand castles, Emilia-tan. Let's make something as big as the iceberg we just made.
text_block_list.orig_text:
砂山作りも奥が深いんだぜ、
エミリアたん。
ここは一つ、
さっきの氷山に匹敵する大物を作ってやろうぜ。

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Huh? So it is something made by hand? Isn't that really difficult?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
手で作るの？
さすがにそれは難しいんじゃないの～？

text_block_list.name: Children in swimsuit
text_block_list.text: So you're going to help me make a castle? Yay!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お山、
みんなでいっしょに作るの？
やったー！

text_block_list.name: Woman in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're starting some new game? Maybe I should take the chance and join in♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
また何か始まるの？
せっかくだし
参加してみよっかな♪

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Everyone suddenly gathered here! With so many hands helping, we might be able to make quite the amazing castle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなが集まってきてくれたわ！
これだけたくさんいれば、
すごーく大きな山が作れるかも。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: This is all thanks to the power of this summery beach, it has opened everyone's heart to cooperate. Well then, I'll do my best as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夏の海の力で、
みなさまの心が開放的になっているのでしょう。
ではわたくしも、
全力で取り組むといたします。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Alright, we're aiming to make a castle that rivals the one in Landosol! Let's go, guys!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よぅし、
目指すはランドソル最高峰だ！
いくぜ、
野郎共！

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: OHHHHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: おーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: It seems the castle is getting taller and taller by the minute...! Isn't everyone too motivated?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みるみる山が高くなってく……！
みんなやる気が溢れすぎてない？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Maybe everyone was restless because they came to the beach but didn't have much time to play due to the heat... I'll help too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海に来たのにあんまり遊べなくて、
みんなうずうずしてたのかもね。
私も手伝うわ！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Lia, so you're as excited about this as Subaru is... Ah well. Guess I'll lend an hand... or paw.
text_block_list.orig_text:
リアまで、
スバルみたいにはしゃいじゃって……
しょうがないな～
ボクも手伝うよ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...Subaru! I wonder if we can make a slide out of this hardened sand like we did with the iceberg?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……スバル！
この砂山でも、
氷山の時みたいに滑り台を作れないかしら？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: As expected of Emilia-tan, it looks like you've got the hang of playing around at the beach! But unfortunately, sand is no good for a slide, it might collapse due to the weight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがはエミリアたん、
海遊びのコツを掴んできたみたいだな！
でも
さすがに砂だと
崩れちゃったり滑れなかったりするかもだ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I see... This "Summah Vaca-shun" thing sure is difficult... KYAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか……
『さまぁばけぇしょん』は難しいのね……
きゃあっ！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Hey Lia, what's wrong? Why did you suddenly fall on your butt?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとリア、
どうしたのさ。
いきなり尻もちついたりして。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's ok. I just got spooked by the waves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫。
ちょっと波に足を取られちゃったわ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Umm...? I don't recall the waves coming this far into the sand before...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
さっきまでは
ここまで波は来ていなかったような……

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow. It seems that before we knew it, the sea's now advancing on us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありゃりゃ。
気付いたら海が近付いてきてるね。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: What a blunder... I'm sorry. I forgot everything about how this area is susceptible to the coming tide. This area will be submerged soon, once the high tide comes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんと……
申し訳ありません、
潮の満ち引きについて失念しておりました。
どうやらこの辺りは、
満潮になると水没してしまうようですね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Aaah, oh no, the castle is collapsing...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ、
山がどんどん崩れていくわ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: It's been so long since I last played at the beach so I MESSED UP! ...Our SHARED DREAM! The peaks of Landosol's castle WILL NEVER BE REAAACHEEDDDD!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海遊びのブランクが長すぎてしくじったーーーー！
俺たちの夢が！
ランドソルのテッペンがぁーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Woman in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text: Haa~, I had a lot of fun♪ Thank you so much for the fun event.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～、
思いっきり遊んじゃった♪
楽しいイベント、
どうもありがとね。

text_block_list.name: Children in swimsuit
text_block_list.text: This sucks, I wanted to make the castle even bigger but it collapsed halfway through. What a shame.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
お山もっと大きくしたかったなー
途中で崩れちゃったの、
くやしいや。

text_block_list.name: Children in swimsuit
text_block_list.text: Yeah, and I'll do my best then! Bye-bye, Onii-chan and Onee-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
がんばる！
お兄ちゃん、
お姉ちゃん、
ばいばーい！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: See you later! Anyway, it seems both the iceberg and the sand castle are both gone. I guess playing at the beach can also lead to such lonely outcomes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
またね！
それにしても、
氷山も砂山も
綺麗さっぱりなくなっちゃったわ。
海の遊びって、
終わりはちょっぴり寂しいのね。

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: But Lia, you looked like you were having a lot of fun during both times~ Seeing you so excited made me happy too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
リアも楽しそうだったね～
リアがはしゃいでるのを見て、
ボクも嬉しくなったよ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks. Making all of that a team effort turned everything even more enjoyable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
ありがと。
みんなで一緒にやったから、
すごーく楽しかったわ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...You're right, {0}. I'd also love to do all of this with you again, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
そうね。
また一緒にやりたい気持ちはあるんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Emilia? You seem a bit depressed for some reason, are you okay...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
エミリアさま？
何やら浮かない様子ですが、
お加減でも……？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I'm okay, don't worry about it. ...I mean, even if I were to promise you to come back here and do this together, I can't in my heart know if I can keep that promise...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
違うの。
……だってその、
また一緒にって約束しても、
私たちには
それを守れるかが分からないから……

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: You're saying that if it's a promise that you're likely to break, it'd be better if you didn't...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
破っちゃいそうな約束だったら
しない方がいいかな？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: ...No, Lady Emilia. Even despite that, let us make a promise. It would be sad not to make a promise for a joyous future together just because you might not be able to keep it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いいえ、
エミリアさま。
それでもやはり、
約束しましょう。
守れないかもしれないから
約束自体しないというのは、
悲しいですから。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Even if there is no guarantee that a promise someone made will come true, there is still meaning in the desire that led to make that promise.
text_block_list.orig_text:
必ず叶うという保証はなくとも、
約束を交わしたいと思う心にこそ
意味がある。
わたくしは
そう思うのです。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Kokkoro-chan...
text_block_list.orig_text: コッコロちゃん……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right, {0}. I promise.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
うん、
そうね。
約束よ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Emilia and the others shared more memories of the summery beach together. Nostalgia for the current today and thoughts of a future someday dwell in everyone's hearts...
text_block_list.orig_text:
夏の海での思い出を分かち合った、エミリアたち。
今日を懐かしむ気持ちと、
いつかの未来へ馳せる想いが、
皆の心に宿っていた……
